n3bd0023429.headline: Ministry of Environment lacks billions for industrial greening, foundries warn
n3bd0023429.summary: Foundries in the Czech Republic warn that the Ministry of Environment lacks billions needed for industrial greening projects.
n3bd0023429.why: Funding shortages for environmental upgrades can impact industrial competitiveness and compliance with EU regulations.
